- **Decision:** Treat this as a broad attention and framing signal; pair it with current fund flows and article-level review before making market or communications decisions.

Monthly volume ranged from 243 in August 2025 to a peak of 978 in April 2026; the first and last months had 489 and 654 respectively [c1]. Overall sentiment labels were 76.0% positive and 23.3% negative [c1]. The geography panel places 61.1% of matched articles with a resolved place; the United States and Ireland account for the largest placed shares [c1]. “Place” means what an article is about, not where it was published [c1]. Critical-headline results include negative coverage of outflows and a withdrawn ETF filing, alongside positive inflow coverage [c1]. The returned examples are not a representative sample of all critical headlines, so they cannot establish how common those frames were.
